newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Colep flotation price set at 2,100 escudos.
newsitem.headline: Colep flotation price set at 2,100 escudos.

text.p: The price in the flotation of Portuguese metal packaging company Colep Portugal-Embalagens, Produtos, Enchimentos e Equipamentos on the Lisbon bourse was fixed at 2,100 escudos per share, the leader of the operation and bookrunner Banco Essi said.
Demand for the shares in the private placement for domestic and international institutional investors was 18,855,476 shares, surpassing the available 3.4 million shares fivefold, it said.
Demand in the Public Offer for Sale (OPV) was 2,312,850 shares, more than four times the available supply of 500,000 shares.
